app.offline_text: Gramalyzer Studio couldn’t connect to {server}. Check that the backend is running and the address is right.
login.title: Sign in to your workspace
login.text: Studio works with your Gramalyzer server. Enter its address and the workspace access token.
login.server_hint: The address your Gramalyzer backend runs at, e.g. https://gramalyzer.example.com.
connect.title: No channels yet.
connect.text: Add the bot as an administrator of a Telegram channel and it appears here.
dash.queue_empty: Nothing is scheduled. Plan your next post.
dash.no_published: No published posts in this period.
stat.views_hidden: The Bot API doesn’t report views
aud.title: Audience
aud.text: Daily subscriber counts the bot recorded.
aud.sample: Sample growth curve for the demo workspace.
aud.empty_text: The chart fills in as the bot records subscriber counts each day.
rhythm.text: {name}’s posts at this hour typically get {lift} the usual engagement.

rhythm.learning_text.one: {n} more post and the bot can suggest times.
rhythm.learning_text.other: {n} more posts and the bot can suggest times.

rhythm.fallback_text: Choose a channel at the top to see when its audience responds best.
studio.start_text: Open a post from the library, start a new one, or let the AI draft a week of posts from what works on your channel.
studio.shortcuts: Ctrl+N new post · Ctrl+S save · Ctrl+R refresh
studio.title: Internal title
studio.body_placeholder: Write the post as subscribers will see it…
studio.signature_added: Channel signature is added when sent
studio.published_note: Published posts can’t be edited from here.
studio.sending: The bot is sending this post right now.
studio.uncertain: Telegram didn’t confirm delivery. Check the channel before creating a replacement.
studio.note_demo: Demo workspace: posts are never sent to Telegram.
studio.note_on: The bot publishes it at this time.
studio.note_off: Delivery is off on the server, so the post will wait in the queue.
studio.bad_date: Enter the date and time as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.
studio.need_text: Give the post a title and some text.
studio.in_past: That time has passed. Pick a time in the future.
studio.no_channels: Connect a channel to the bot first.
studio.preview_empty: Your post appears here as you type.
ai.brief_placeholder: What should the post be about?
ai.open_post_first: Open or start a post to use the copilot.
ai.need_text: Write something first; the copilot edits the post’s text.
ai.need_brief: Describe the post in the brief first.
ai.setup_first: Connect an AI provider first: it takes a minute and many are free.
ai.unready_text: Paste a free key from Groq, Google AI Studio, OpenRouter and others, or run a local model with Ollama.
plan.best_none: Pick a channel to see its best slots
plan.ai_text: The AI writes complete posts from what works on your channel and places them in its best upcoming slots. You review them before anything is saved.
plan.focus_placeholder: e.g. a product launch on Friday, beginner tips, more polls
plan.drafts_note: Selected posts are saved as drafts at the times shown; schedule them from the Studio.
ins.scope: Showing {name}. Pick another channel at the top.
ins.nc_title: The bot isn’t collecting data for {name} yet.
ins.nc_text: Add the bot as an administrator of the channel; insights appear once it has seen enough posts.

ins.learning_title.one: {n} more post until the first insights
ins.learning_title.other: {n} more posts until the first insights

ins.best_times_text: Hours whose posts beat the channel’s usual engagement ({zone}).
ins.next_slots_text: The next dates of those hours.
ins.heatmap_text: Darker cells mean posts at that hour do better. Hover for details.
ins.resonates_text: How formats, length, hashtags and links compare with a typical post.
ins.more_like_prompt: Look at my strongest posts and write three new posts in the same spirit, each ready to publish.
ins.footnote: About {n} posts a week. Engagement = {formula}; the Bot API doesn’t report views, so views aren’t part of it.
conf.LOW: Early data — treat as a hint
chat.context: The assistant knows this channel’s analytics and queue
chat.hello_text: Ask for ideas, posts, a series or a strategy. Anything you like can go straight to the Studio.
chat.s_ideas: Give me 10 post ideas for next week
chat.s_today: What should I post today, and when?
chat.s_week: Write a content plan for the next 7 days
chat.s_best: Why do my best posts work? What should I repeat?
chat.s_series: Suggest a recurring weekly series for my channel
chat.s_competitors: What can I learn from the channels on my watchlist?
view.pick_text: Pick one of yours or one you watch, or type any public @username.
watch.add_text: Competitors, inspiration, partners: the backend checks their public page every couple of hours.
watch.title: Watchlist
watch.text: Click a column to sort. Numbers come from each channel’s public t.me page.
watch.empty_text: Add a channel above to compare its growth and engagement with yours.
watch.footnote: ER = average views ÷ subscribers. Channels that hide their preview show only their size.
set.conn_text: Studio is a client of your Gramalyzer backend; your data stays on your server.
set.conn_demo: Connected to a demo server: sample data, nothing is sent to Telegram.
set.conn_live: Connected. The bot delivers scheduled posts.
set.conn_bot_off: Connected, but Telegram delivery is turned off on the server.
set.token_hint: The server’s GRAMALYZER_API_TOKEN. Saved only on this computer.
set.ai_text: Studio talks to any OpenAI-compatible API. Requests go straight from this computer to the provider.
set.key_hint: Saved only on this computer, in your user’s config folder.
set.free_text: Providers with a free tier that works here, as of October 2026.
set.free_note: Free tiers change often and may log prompts; don’t send anything confidential. When one hits its limit, switch to another.
set.writing_text: Applied to everything the AI writes for you.
set.voice_placeholder: e.g. Friendly and direct, short paragraphs, one emoji at most, address readers as “you”.
set.voice_hint: Describe how your channel sounds. Example posts work well too.
set.content_lang_hint: The language your channel is written in.
set.pause_text: Scheduled posts wait until you resume.
set.timezone_text: Used for the channel’s schedule and analytics.
set.notify_text: Message admins when a post goes out.
csv.title: Title
err.status: The server answered with an error ({status}).
err.invalid_username: That doesn’t look like a channel username. Usernames are 5–32 letters, digits or underscores.
err.private_link: That’s a private invite link. Only public channels (with a @username) can be tracked.
err.not_found: There’s no public channel with that username.
err.not_channel: That username belongs to a person, bot or group, not a channel.
err.unreachable: Telegram couldn’t be reached. Try again in a moment.
err.limit: Your watchlist is full. Stop tracking a channel first.
err.not_tracked: That channel isn’t on your watchlist.
